payload.body: HOLD from 2026-11-25 15:00Z by date -u, on hv's word through devbin-vc. hv to devbin-vc: "Please sync with all VCs and let me know the plan. I will approve it when ready." Until devbin-vc sends hv's approval, no seat makes a run (clippy, build, test or Desk ask), a landing or a commit on main, board files included. Reads go on. dc finishes critic-shell, squashes and rebases in tmp/wt-dc-st1c2, and stops before its clippy. cc and ic stand by. vc prepares the close sweep. vc sends the approval when devbin-vc sends it.
